patch_description: The current approach uses greedy construction from random starts, 2-opt, then one SA pass. Key parameters: 25 restarts, SA time budget 30s, cooling 0.999. Improvement: wrap the whole pipeline in an iterated "ruin-and-recreate" loop under a global time budget — remove 3-6 random transactions from the current best schedule and greedily re-insert them at the best positions (cheapest makespan), then apply a short 2-opt pass, accepting improvements only. This diversifies at the restart level while preserving cost-guided selection, and iterates far more intensively than single-shot SA on one solution. SA is kept as a final polish with slightly higher initial temperature and reheating on improvement.
